title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
original_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
plot_overview: Rare footage and untold stories trace a British rock band’s rise from its Manchester roots to global stardom, alongside its reunion for a major live tour. The documentary pairs archive material with concert performances and reflections from fans around the world.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you’re a fan of arena-sized rock, concert footage, and a nostalgic look at a band’s enduring appeal; Not for you if you want an in-depth account of its history or internal conflicts.
review_summary: Pros: thrilling live performances; powerful crowd response; nostalgic archive footage | Cons: little band history; avoids contentious topics; limited backstage insight
